title: ilex zippeliana
intro: Ilex zippeliana, commonly known as the Philippine holly, is a plant species in the family Aquifoliaceae. It has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions due to its rich content of bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, providing health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Ilex zippeliana include wound healing, antimicrobial effects, and potential anti-diabetic properties. Further research is needed to fully understand the bioactive constituents and therapeutic potential of Ilex zippeliana.
